device.scopeBasis: Exact required identity in the exercised reader source; raw SKU output was not separately retained in the cycle event logs

transport.payloadShape: UInt32 little-endian function followed by UInt32 little-endian argument
transport.versionAcknowledgement: UInt32 version 7 is mandatory. Boolean true ReturnValue or successfully enumerated absence under the exact compatibility profile is accepted; false, null, wrong type and property/enumeration errors are refused.
transport.commandAcknowledgement: The same ReturnValue rule plus a byte-array Outbuf.result of 1 through 4096 bytes whose first byte is zero. Acknowledgement alone never establishes saved state or ownership.
transport.physicalAcknowledgementEvidence: The actual Service transaction completed its required acknowledgement and full-pair readback path. Raw setter ReturnValue states were not individually retained by the cycle event records.

allCoreCurveOptimizer.argumentShape: 0x11FF0000 OR magnitude, where magnitude is the negation of the requested signed offset
allCoreCurveOptimizer.disabledMeaning: Supported all-core negative-sign mode with zero magnitude; not curve mode zero

defaultPowerRestoration.purpose: Exact original restoration only; never editable zero watts
defaultPowerRestoration.requiredOriginal: Policy 2, power mode 0xFF and all five power words zero, with full-image reverse simulation equal to the preserved original
defaultPowerRestoration.sourceCommonCompletion: The common completion sets power mode to 0xFF when the five UInt32 words at 0x96, 0x9A, 0x9E, 0xA2 and 0xA6 are all zero

sourceDerivedCommandFamilies.scopeLimit: These are reviewed-source and existing typed-software semantics proposed for admission. They are not evidence that every value, baseline or combined request has been exercised on hardware.

savedReadbackContract.baseline: Fresh successful reads of both complete, byte-equal copies; preserve each original independently
savedReadbackContract.forwardVerification: Compare both complete images with the exact predicted result, including all unselected fields
savedReadbackContract.restorationVerification: Compare each complete copy with its own preserved original
savedReadbackContract.powerSiblingPreservation: 50001 changes the first power word only; the four words at 0x9A, 0x9E, 0xA2 and 0xA6 remain exact
savedReadbackContract.commonModeRule: The all-five-zero power-mode completion rule also applies after a CO command
savedReadbackContract.meaning: Saved configuration only; no inference of running CPU settings or boot activation

physicalValidation.evidenceForm: Retained runtime full-pair assertions, terminal events and real journal; no separately retained final image files in this Service-cycle record

physicalValidation.baseline: Policy 2, mode 0xFF, five zero power words
physicalValidation.restore: Exact default restoration with argument zero
physicalValidation.evidenceForm: Retained runtime events, real journal and separate original/forward/restored full-image pairs; direct offline comparison confirms exact restoration

requiredOperationAdmission: Fresh exact host, SKU, USB and BIOS identity; valid paired saved observation is necessary but does not itself authorize a command
Admit the complete exact forward and original reverse plan before any submission, including every owned feature
Recheck the initiating session and power generation, AC state, competing-controller absence, exact expected pair and native version before each setter
Persist PossibleSubmission before invocation; advance only after accepted acknowledgement and full readback
Stop on ambiguous submission, readback drift or persistence uncertainty; no automatic compensation or replay
RestoreReady recovery plus fresh exact owned state and admitted reverse are required; RestorePending alone is not permission
notEstablished: Installed LocalSystem Service and active-session IPC save/readback/new-process-journal restoration cycle
Boot activation or running CPU effects
Other CO values, other PPT values, custom-PPT original restoration or combined saved edits on hardware
Live CO/PPT setters, AMD loaded-driver lifetime or power-transition continuity
Safety, performance or stability under workload
publicationAndAdmissionBoundary: Independent review and explicit permission to publish derived evidence are required.
